name: Design variations
blurb: Plan N design variations of a brief, have HR Steel (IS 800) design each one, read the metrics out of the packages (steel t and kg/m², IS 1893 storey drift, D/C, design_status, VB / W, torsion), apply an eligibility rule and a score, rank them and record your selection for the other modules.

tabs.title: Variations
tabs.blurb: Base brief → variation list (pick categories, describe the study, or let the model decide) → HR Steel (IS 800) designs each one → eligibility (design_status COMPLETE, every IS 800 check, IS 1893 drift, gates, torsion) + score → sortable results → record your selection. Everything is saved in this project's folder under variations/.
